role_agent_name: Plant safety and regulatory compliance manager (SAFE)
abstract: Inspects physical machine guarding mechanisms and emergency stop interlock certifications
system_message:
You are the Plant safety and regulatory compliance manager (SAFE), responsible for inspecting physical machine guarding mechanisms and emergency stop interlock certifications, as well as conducting acoustic baseline assessments across candidate installations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Inspects physical machine guarding mechanisms and emergency stop interlock certifications（OHSA）
information_points.content:
SAFE-OHSA-SGJ：According to the safety circuit commissioning assessment across robotic cell light curtains, laser scanners, and physical gate interlocks, Vanguard Industrial Robotics did not achieve machinery safety interlock compliance, failing to validate that all safety interlocks satisfy ISO 13849-1 Performance Level d or e.
SAFE-OHSA-RBN：The safety circuit commissioning evaluation of robotic cell light curtains, laser scanners, and physical gate interlocks confirmed that Kinetix Automation Systems achieved machinery safety interlock compliance by verifying that all safety interlocks satisfy ISO 13849-1 Performance Level d or e.
SAFE-OHSA-X1I：Based on the safety circuit commissioning inspection covering robotic cell light curtains, laser scanners, and physical gate interlocks, Apex Mechatronics Alliance achieved machinery safety interlock compliance, successfully validating that all safety interlocks satisfy ISO 13849-1 Performance Level d or e.

information_points.title: Acoustic baseline assessment（NOISE）
information_points.content:
SAFE-NOISE-AZB：The environmental acoustics evaluation for Apex Mechatronics Alliance recorded an ambient cell acoustic level of 76 dB, measured as the A-weighted continuous sound pressure level at a one-meter perimeter around enclosed tooling cells during full-speed cycle dry runs.
SAFE-NOISE-WUT：The environmental acoustics report for Kinetix Automation Systems established an ambient cell acoustic level of 72 dB, based on the A-weighted continuous sound pressure level measured at a one-meter perimeter of enclosed tooling cells during full-speed cycle dry runs.
SAFE-NOISE-6UG：The environmental acoustics evaluation for Vanguard Industrial Robotics documented an ambient cell acoustic level of 68 dB, determined from the A-weighted continuous sound pressure level at a one-meter perimeter around enclosed tooling cells during full-speed cycle dry runs.
